directions.title: A / CORAL COURIER
directions.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: PLAYER CHARACTER concept direction sheet for an irreverent top-down city action game; concept only, not a completed model. Original unbranded adult character. Grounded in a darker vibrant cyberpunk island city of ordinary architecture with blue night ambient, cyan and pink practical lights; smooth stylized 3D, chunky rounded readable forms, playful attitude, clean opaque material regions, modest neon accents. Anatomical humanoid near 1.8m, exaggerated readable head and hands but not chibi. Keep same character/outfit/proportions in every panel.
Create a polished landscape art-director sheet on dark petrol background. Left 60%: LARGE full-body front three-quarter view, feet fully visible, relaxed confident neutral stance; a smaller rear three-quarter view beside it. Right column: TRUE VERTICAL OVERHEAD view looking straight down at top of head/shoulders, north is top, character faces up-page, arms slightly out so elbows readable; no isometric angle here. Below it: a solid flat ivory silhouette of that EXACT overhead shape, same orientation, black background. Both overhead and silhouette generously sized for inspection. Small palette swatches. Simple header label as specified. No decorative city scene competing with character. Avoid realistic grit, fine straps/text, logos, military armor, giant backpacks, oversized helmets, long coats or capes obscuring leg motion, overglowing whole body, weapon designs. No weapons in this sheet; hands visible and available for later pistol/two-hand SMG/shoulder launcher poses. This is an aesthetic overhead enlargement, not a measured game screenshot.
Header text exactly: "A / CORAL COURIER".
Direction A: compact athletic and androgynous adult urban courier; short dark cropped hair with a single substantial ivory forelock visible from above, warm medium skin tone. Broad softly rounded CORAL cropped bomber jacket with an IVORY upper shoulder yoke as ONE clearly readable arch across shoulders/back, dark petrol loose tapered cargo trousers, chunky ivory sneakers with coral soles, fingerless dark gloves. Practical small waist pouch only. Short jacket ends at waist, no hanging tails. Rounded compact shoulder/head outline, obvious bright shoulder band from overhead and separate dark forearms. Three-quarter expression a wry smirk. Friendly troublemaker with practical street clothes, ordinary person shaped by the neon city, not a superhero. Keep coral as strongest clothing region; ivory shoulder/head marker is broad painted fabric not emissive.
